cases.name: Mary Heinz
cases.narrative:
On 7/4/2023, Heinz’s body was located, near a county road about five miles north of Poteet. Her remains were found on the side of the road, next to a fence and some tall grass. 

On July 4, investigators had conducted surveillance on Montoya, who was working at a fast food restaurant in Pleasanton, TX. He was seen moving his vehicle close to a dumpster and got out of his car around 9 p.m. before grabbing two plastic trash bags and throwing them in the dumpsters. Deputies with the ACSO stopped to interview Montoya after he left work about 45 minutes later. At the same time, the sheriff said an investigator went to the dumpster to retrieve the trash bags and found they had partial human remains.

On 6/29/2023, her roommate Laura West's body had been found in the home they shared when firefighter's responded to the house on fire.
